summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature. Changes: monai/data/utils.py (iter_patch now yields (patch, coords) pairs with [start, stop] rows including channel; set_rnd skips dunder attribute names; docstrings updated), monai/data/grid_dataset.py (new PatchIter; GridPatchDataset rewritten to take patch_iter, transform, with_coordinates; PatchDataset docstring np.float -> float), monai/data/__init__.py (exports PatchIter), docs/source/data.rst (PatchIter autodoc entry), tests/test_grid_dataset.py (TestGridPatchDataset with test_shape, test_loading_array, test_no_length). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Line lengths were checked by grep: all new lines are within 120 columns. Risk: the pinned single-process patch values are given to 4 decimals but are checked at rtol 1e-5, so test_loading_array may fail if the true values have more digits. The docstring example output is derived by hand.
